meta.notes: A frog variant: asset_id is its texture (48 by 48 pixels) under textures/entity/frog/; frogs have no baby texture, as tadpoles are a mob of their own. A tadpole picks its variant from the biome it grows up in, here a mangrove swamp with priority 1. Try /summon minecraft:frog ~ ~ ~ {variant:"msm_examples:sapphire_frog"}.
